name: inZOI 1st Anniversary Gift
description: A commemorative item originally distributed by inZOI Studios to influencers to mark the game's first anniversary. It is shared here as a collectible for players who want the piece in their own builds even if they did not receive it directly. Congratulations to inZOI on one year, here's to many more.
highlights: Commemorative piece marking inZOI's first anniversary
Originally an influencer-exclusive item, now shared for anyone to use
A fun addition for players who want a piece of the game's history in their builds
installation: This is a collectible decor item rather than a functional furniture set, so where it appears in the build catalog can vary by patch. After installing, check Build Mode's Decor category first; if it is not there, try searching "Anniversary" across the other build categories.

fileManifest.description: A item given to influencers by inZOI Studios as a gift for the game 1st Anniversary. Congratulations to inZOI, wishing it many more years of developement and success!
